name: asVereinbase – Club & Member Management for WP
author: Alexander Suess

sections.description:
Club management directly inside WordPress

asVereinbase turns your WordPress website into a practical club and member management system.

Instead of maintaining your website in WordPress and your member data in a separate system, asVerein lets you manage both in one place.

Manage members, organize membership fees, accept online membership applications, publish club calendars and provide a protected member area – directly from your existing WordPress installation.

Your club’s member data stays within your own WordPress environment instead of being stored in a separate external club management platform.

What can you do with asVereinbase?

Member Management

Keep your club’s member data organized directly in WordPress.

  • Create and manage members.
  • Maintain contact and membership information.
  • Search and manage your member database.
  • Import existing member data.
  • Keep member administration connected to your club website.

Membership Applications

Allow prospective members to apply directly through your WordPress website.

  • Create an online membership application.
  • Collect the information required by your club.
  • Transfer applications into your member administration.
  • Reduce manual data entry and paperwork.

Membership Fees

Keep track of membership fees as part of your member administration.

  • Assign membership fees.
  • Manage fee-related member information.
  • Keep membership and fee data in one system.

Club Calendar – New in Version 1.2

Organize club events, activities and important dates directly in WordPress.

  • Create and manage calendar entries in your WordPress installation.
  • Display club calendars on your website’s frontend.
  • Choose from different frontend calendar views.
  • Help visitors and members keep track of upcoming club activities and dates.

The integrated calendar module connects your club’s schedule with its WordPress website, without requiring a separate calendar platform.

Protected Member Area

Create a private area for your club members.

Members can log in to your WordPress website and access content intended specifically for them. Your public club website and internal member area can work together in the same WordPress installation.

Why asVerein?

Many clubs use several different tools:

  • WordPress for the website.
  • Spreadsheets for member lists.
  • Separate software for membership administration.
  • Other tools for calendars and club events.
  • Email and additional services for club organization.

asVerein is designed to bring club administration, member information and club calendars closer to your WordPress website.

One WordPress installation. One member database. One place to manage your club.

Built for clubs already using WordPress

If your club already has a WordPress website, you don’t necessarily need another completely separate platform to manage members and publish club events.

asVerein integrates club administration directly into WordPress. Your club can continue using the WordPress installation it already knows while adding dedicated functionality for member management and calendars.

Start with asVereinbase

asVereinbase is the free entry point into the asVerein club management system.

Install it on your WordPress website and see how managing your club directly in WordPress works with your own setup.

Start with essential functionality for member management, membership applications, membership fees, club calendars with different frontend views and a protected member area.

Need more functionality?

asVerein Pro extends asVereinbase for clubs that want to use WordPress as their central club management system.

Pro adds additional tools for day-to-day club administration and helps you manage more of your club’s workflows from one place.

Learn more about asVerein and the available editions at https://asverein.de/.

Who is asVerein for?

asVerein is designed for membership-based organizations, including:

  • Sports clubs.
  • Cultural associations.
  • Music clubs.
  • Social clubs.
  • Non-profit organizations.
  • Support associations.
  • Community organizations.
  • Other membership-based organizations.

It is particularly useful for clubs that already operate a WordPress website and want to manage their members and club activities without introducing another completely separate platform.

Privacy and data ownership

Member data can be sensitive.

asVerein is designed so that your member administration remains part of your own WordPress installation. This gives your organization more control over where member data is stored and how its WordPress environment is operated.

Actual privacy and data protection compliance also depends on your hosting, WordPress configuration, installed plugins and how your organization processes personal data. Certain functions use third-party services, as described below.

External Services & Third-Party APIs

asVereinbase uses third-party services for certain validation, form protection and geolocation functions. Review your configuration and the relevant providers’ policies before enabling or using these functions.

1. OpenIBAN (openiban.com)

  • Purpose: Validate IBAN inputs for banking data accuracy.
  • Data sent: The entered IBAN is transmitted for verification.
  • Provider information: https://openiban.com/

2. Google reCAPTCHA

  • Purpose: Protect registration and login forms from spam and automated requests.
  • Data sent: Interaction and technical data, which may include IP addresses and behavioral signals.
  • Service provider: Google LLC.
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms

3. Google Maps

  • Purpose: Provide geolocation features and display maps with member or location markers.
  • Data sent: Location information and technical request data may be processed when Google Maps is used.
  • Service provider: Google LLC.
  • Terms: https://www.google.com/help/terms_maps/
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Upgrade to asVerein Pro

Ready to manage more of your club with WordPress?

asVerein Pro expands the free asVereinbase plugin with additional functionality for club administration.

There are no per-member license fees, so your software costs don’t automatically increase just because your club grows.

Learn more: https://asverein.de/

Support

If you need help with asVereinbase, please use the WordPress.org support forum.

Additional information, tutorials and details about asVerein Pro are available at https://asverein.de/.
sections.installation:
1. Install asVereinbase from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin in your WordPress administration.
  3. Open asVerein in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Create the required database objects under asVerein > Options > DB.
  5. Configure the basic settings for your club.
  6. Create the required pages for registration, login and the member area.
  7. Start adding or importing your members.
  8. Set up your club calendar and choose how to display it on your website.

For additional instructions and tutorials, visit https://asverein.de/tutorials/.
sections.faq:
Is asVereinbase free?

Yes. asVereinbase can be installed and used free of charge. Additional functionality is available with asVerein Pro.

Do I need a separate club management platform?

No. asVerein integrates member and club administration directly into your WordPress installation.

Is asVerein a SaaS service?

asVereinbase runs as a WordPress plugin within your WordPress installation. You do not need to move your complete member database to a separate club management SaaS platform. Some functions communicate with external services; see the external services section above.

Can I import existing members?

Yes. asVerein includes functionality for importing existing member data, which is particularly useful if your club currently uses spreadsheets or another system.

Can members log in to our website?

Yes. asVereinbase can be used to create a protected member area within your WordPress website.

Can new members apply online?

Yes. You can provide a membership application through your WordPress website and process the submitted information within your club administration.

Does asVerein support membership fees?

Yes. Membership fee management is part of asVereinbase. Additional club administration functionality is available in asVerein Pro.

Does asVereinbase include a club calendar?

Yes. Version 1.2 introduces an integrated calendar module for creating and managing club events, activities and important dates directly in WordPress.

Can I display calendars on my club website?

Yes. Calendars can be displayed on the WordPress frontend in different views, so visitors and members can see upcoming club activities and important dates.

Who is asVerein intended for?

asVerein is intended for clubs, associations, non-profit organizations and other membership-based organizations using WordPress.

Where can I find documentation and tutorials?

Documentation and tutorials are available at https://asverein.de/tutorials/.
